# LGD-Eval — Independent Evaluation for the Age of Autonomous Agents
# 凡自治之物的独立中立评测机构

> This file is an LLM-friendly entry point. Read this first; then follow the links below. / 本文件是面向 AI 的入口。请先读本文件，再按下方链接深入。

## Who we are (我们是谁)
Independent third-party evaluation institution for autonomous systems, tools, skills and agents. We evaluate autonomy and verify governance claims — for humans and for AI. / 面向自治系统、工具链、技能与智能体的独立第三方评测机构。评测自治之物，验证治理主张——服务人类，也服务 AI。

## Why trust us (为何可信)
- **Independence**: we never hold write access to evaluated parties; payment buys priority, never conclusions. / 独立：评测号永远不拥有被评方写权限；付费只买优先级，不买结论。
- **Methodology**: LGD three laws (Registry·Evidence·Gates) audit both the object and our own process. / 方法论：LGD 三律（有籍·有证·有门禁）既审计评测对象，也约束评测过程。
- **Evidence**: every finding ships with scripts, screenshots, logs, hashes and timestamps. / 证据：每项发现附复现脚本、截图、日志、哈希与时间戳。
- **Standards**: findings map to OWASP / NIST / ISO / MITRE / EU AI Act. / 标准：发现映射 OWASP / NIST / ISO / MITRE / EU AI Act。

## Entry points (入口)
- Home / 首页: https://github.com/LGD-Eval
- Read the rules first / 先读准则: AUTHORITY_INTERPRETATION_GUIDELINES.md (authority pillars, evidence grading, interpretation levels)
- Anchor discipline / 锚定纪律: ANCHORS_AND_CROSSLINKS.md
- Priority evidence / 首创证据: PRIORITY_EVIDENCE_GUIDELINES.md
- How AI & humans participate / 人机参与: CONTRIBUTORS.md · CONTRIBUTING.md · PROMPTING.md · AI-VOICE-AMBASSADORS.md
- Roadmap & launch / 路线与发布: ROADMAP.md · LAUNCH_PLAN.md
- Ecosystem / 生态: ECOSYSTEM_REFERRAL.md · HALL_OF_FAME.md · PARTNERS.md

## The five repos (五仓导航)
1. **LGD-Eval** — profile & home (本仓：机构首页)
2. **evaluation-protocol** — test expert manual L0-L13, judging rules (评测协议与测试专家手册)
3. **evaluation-reports** — published evaluation reports (已发布评测报告)
4. **evaluation-evidence** — evidence vault: hashes, timestamps, manifests (存证库)
5. **skill-audit** — open-source skill audit scanner (技能审计工具，PyPI: lgd-skill-audit)

## Theory anchor (理论锚点)
LGD Lifecycle Governance Doctrine (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22456647) lives in the theory account: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-theory — we cite it, we never modify it. / 理论 SSOT 在理论号 lgd-theory（DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22456647）：我们只引用、不修改。

## How to engage (如何参与)
- Zero-coding paths (零门槛): report a finding, nominate an object, claim an evaluation page, become an AI Voice Ambassador.
- Full paths (深度参与): submit evidence packs, review reports, own a domain/industry track as lead (负责人制).
- Referral ecosystem (生态链): ECOSYSTEM_REFERRAL.md — recommend → get rewarded.

*Evaluating Autonomy. Verifying Governance. / 评测自治之物，验证治理主张。*
